description.value:
As an action, choose yourself and up to three allies benefiting from your Prototype Imbuements that you can see. You forge a magical lattice that lasts for 1 minute. The effect remains on those creatures even if they move, as long as they were within line of sight when you created it.

  • Overclock: Each affected creature is under the effects of the haste spell (no concentration required, ends for all at the same time).

  • Auto-Stabilize: The first time each affected creature would drop to 0 HP, they instead drop to 1 HP (once per creature per lattice).

  • Magical Resistance: Each affected creature has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

You can use this feature once per long rest. You can cast it again by expending a 6th-level spell slot.
